title: 第7章 黄阶道种第8章 突破的路
content_zh:
余烬从漆黑的夜色里走出来，一只手抱着一颗滚圆的石脑袋，此时苏三两二人还在庭院两边站着，他本想就这样走过去，却忽然脚步顿住。
他回过身，表情略带怪异地看着这对奇葩的武将组合，“你们这是……”
此时的何千斤有一只眼睛黑了一圈，脸颊上还有着明显的伤痕，整个人颇为狼狈，嘴里重重地哼了一声，撇过头似乎不愿意跟余烬搭话。
苏三两擦拭着臂甲上的刮痕，朝着余烬怀中的石脑袋看了一眼，眼神明显闪过一丝异色，却假装没有看见，只是朝着余烬勉强笑了笑，又低头开始擦拭盔甲。
这二人好像跟谁打了一架，而且吃亏了！
余烬心里纳闷，余氏的虎咆营武将，据闻最次的也是第五境修为，再加上在余侯府内，是谁吃了豹子胆，敢修理这两位？
关键是，这俩人好像吃了亏还不敢出声的样子，看来对方是个狠人！
余烬见二人不愿意搭话，他也没再理会，将手中抱着的石头扔在庭院门边，便往冷院那边赶。
等到余烬不见了身影，何千斤重重地哼了一声。
苏三两不自觉地扫了眼地上的石脑袋，那正是一颗白虎石像的头颅！
他沉默沉吟半响，才笑道：“别不服气，大家都是四境，你吓得连灵兵都差点掏出来了，还被打成狗，不服气不行吧？”
何千斤怒道：“我只是没敢下死手，她毕竟是千金之躯，万一弄伤了一根发丝，族山那群老人还没开口，三爷就会先弄死我，而且压着境界对打，老子浑身不自在！”
苏三两也不拆穿，只是笑道：“啊对对对！”
何千斤大怒，“你还不是那个死猪头，还让人小姑娘小心一点，结果连龟壳都差点让人削了！”
“闹归闹，别人生攻击，你个鸟人。”苏三两低下头，擦了擦盔甲上的划痕，“难怪她会被族山那边如此重视，好在她只是四境，若是跟我们同境，咱哥俩今天恐怕要交代在这里。”
何千斤脸色一沉，“都怪那个叫余烬的小子，咱以后最好离他远点……”
“你们两个在哪里嘀咕什么？”一座铁塔般伟岸的身影从夜色中走出，瞬间将二人笼罩在内。
“三爷！”苏何二人心中一惊，慌忙弯腰行礼。
余重三淡淡地嗯了一声，“看见余烬了？”
苏三两答道：“刚走没多久。”

余重三点头，“你们两个传我将令，让虎咆营派一支夜鹰出去，查一下余烬消失的三年里，究竟去了哪里，做了什么，事无巨细，我全部都要知道；另外，从今晚开始，你们两个暗中跟着余烬，将他的一举一动汇报给我。”
苏何二人同时愣了一下。
余重三皱眉道：“你们，有问题？”
“没有！”二人异口同声。
苏三两想了想说道：“听闻大荒城内，许多人都知道余烬少爷回来了，因为当初打碎那件王赐之物的缘故，恐怕不少人会对付他，要是他遇上危险，我们该……”
余重三看了眼地上的白虎头颅，“你们只需要跟着，其余什么都不用做，他若没死不用管他，若是死了更不用你们管！”
……
回到冷院，余烬便看见陈青换了一身青色的长裙，站在那棵老梧桐树下方。
虽然背对着余烬，可是月光依旧将她完美的腰肢与臀线勾勒得一览无余。
余烬扫了一眼，正要离开，陈青忽有所感，转过身来，开口将他喊住，“余烬少爷，稍等一下。”
余烬停下脚步，“有事？”
“你若是找小蝶小姐的话，她刚刚睡下。”陈青将一缕青丝挽在耳后，露出精致的耳垂轮廓，在月光的衬托下美的让人心动，“她让我转告少爷，你以后想去哪，千万千万要记得把她带上，不然……她会很不开心。”
“这是怕我跑了吗？”余烬苦笑，心里却生出一丝歉疚，大概自己消失的三年，那小丫头也并不好过吧。
content_en:
Ember walked out of the dark night, holding a round stone head in one hand. At this time, two and three Sus were still standing on both sides of the courtyard. He wanted to just walk over, but suddenly his steps stopped.
He turned around and looked at this strange pair of military commanders with a slightly strange expression, "What are you..."
At this time, He Qianjin had a black eye in one eye and obvious scars on his cheek. He was quite embarrassed. He snorted heavily and turned his head as if he was unwilling to talk to Yu Yan.
Su Sanliang wiped the scratches on the arm armor and glanced at the stone head in Yu Huan's arms. A strange color flashed through his eyes, but he pretended not to see it. He just smiled at Yu Huan and lowered his head again to wipe the armor.
These two people seemed to have had a fight with someone, and they suffered a loss!
Yu Jin was wondering in his heart. It was said that the generals of the Tiger Roaring Camp of the Yu clan were at the fifth level. In addition, in the Yuhou Mansion, who dared to dare to challenge these two people?
The key point is that these two people seem to have suffered a loss and dare not speak out. It seems that the other party is a cruel person!
When Yu Jin saw that the two of them were unwilling to talk, he ignored them. He threw the stone in his hand by the courtyard door and hurried towards Leng Yuan.
When Hu Yan disappeared, He Qianjin snorted heavily.
Su Sanliang glanced at the stone head on the ground unconsciously. It was the head of a white tiger stone statue!
He was silent for a while and then smiled and said: "Don't be unconvinced, everyone is in the fourth realm. You were so scared that you almost took out your spiritual weapon, and you were beaten into a dog. Can't you be unconvinced?"
He Qianjin said angrily: "I just didn't dare to kill her. After all, she is a woman of gold. If she hurts a hair, the third master will kill me first before those old people in Zushan say anything, and they will fight under the pressure of their realm. I feel uncomfortable all over!"
Su Sanliang didn't expose it, just smiled and said: "Ah, yes, yes!"
He Qianjin was furious, "Aren't you that stupid pig head? You asked the little girl to be careful, but in the end, even the turtle shell was almost peeled off!"
"Nao Gui Nao, attack others, you birdie." Su Sanliang lowered his head and wiped the scratches on his armor, "No wonder she is so valued by the Clan Mountain. Fortunately, she is only in the fourth realm. If she were in the same realm as us, I am afraid that we two brothers will have to answer here today."
He Qianjin's face darkened, "It's all my fault that boy named Yu Yan, we'd better stay away from him in the future..."
"What are you two talking about?" A tall figure like an iron tower walked out of the night and enveloped the two of them in an instant.
"Third Master!" Su and He were startled and hurriedly bent down to salute.
Yu Zhongsan hummed lightly, "Did you see the embers?"
Su Sanliang replied: "I just left not long ago."
Yu Zhongsan nodded, "You two pass my order to the Tiger Roar Camp to send a Nighthawk out to find out where and what he has been doing in the three years since he disappeared. I want to know everything. In addition, starting tonight, you two will secretly follow Yi Ji and report his every move to me."
Su He and Su He were stunned for a moment at the same time.
Yu Zhongsan frowned and said, "Do you have a problem?"
"No!" they both said in unison.
Su Sanliang thought for a while and said: "I heard that many people in Dahuang City know that Master Yu Jin is back. Because he broke the thing given by the king, I am afraid many people will deal with him. If he is in danger, we should..."
Yu Zhongsan glanced at the white tiger's head on the ground, "You just need to follow, you don't need to do anything else. If he is not dead, you don't need to worry about him, and if he is dead, you don't need to worry about him!"
…
Returning to Leng Yuan, Yu Yan saw Chen Qing changing into a long blue dress and standing under the old sycamore tree.
Although her back was turned to Ember, the moonlight still outlined her perfect waist and hip line.
Yu Yan glanced at him and was about to leave when Chen Qing suddenly felt something. He turned around and called out to him, "Yu Jin"Master Jin, wait a moment. "
Yan Yan stopped and said, "Is something wrong? "
"If you are looking for Miss Xiaodie, she has just fallen asleep. "Chen Qing tucked a strand of green silk behind her ear, revealing the delicate outline of her earlobe, which was so beautiful under the moonlight. "She asked me to tell the young master, wherever you want to go in the future, you must remember to take her with you, otherwise... she will be very unhappy. "
"Are you afraid that I'll run away? "Yi Yan smiled bitterly, but a trace of guilt arose in his heart. Probably the three years since he disappeared, the little girl must not have had an easy time.
